question: 第3个训练日哪个组的平均游泳速度最慢
sql: SELECT group_name, AVG(mouse_speed) AS avg_speed_px FROM (SELECT v.group_name, v.mouse_id, AVG(tm.value) AS mouse_speed FROM videos AS v JOIN trial_metrics AS tm ON v.video_id = tm.video_id WHERE v.phase = 'training_day' AND v.date_dir = '0806' AND tm.metric = 'speed_px' AND tm.calc_status = 'ok' AND tm.algo_version = 'v1-polyline-ok-frames' GROUP BY v.group_name, v.mouse_id) AS mouse_daily_metrics GROUP BY group_name ORDER BY avg_speed_px ASC LIMIT 1
caliber_note:
动物口径：动物 = (group_name, mouse_id)（标准表达 COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(group_name, '|', mouse_id))；animal_code 是组-鼠-试次编码，不能当动物数）
聚合口径：组间统计的推荐聚合口径是逐鼠-逐日：先按 (group_name, mouse_id, date_dir) 聚合再组间比较；试次直均有伪重复风险（统计单位=动物，docs/09 Q17）
阶段口径：统计与对比必须先声明 phase（训练期/探测期），两阶段不可混算
